description: An append-only ledger of sourced, dated, confidence-scored claims your agent cites and you audit

name: org.linkedparticles/particles

environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key. Required for the tools that call a model — `query` composes a cited natural-language answer, and the semantic half of `lint` reasons over claim pairs. The accessors that only read the store (`particle_show`, `particles_list`, `subjects_*`, `events_*`, `graph_view`, `quality_report`) work without it.
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: SQLAlchemy URL of the belief store to serve. Defaults to `sqlite+aiosqlite:///./particles.db` in the working directory.
environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a `config.yaml` holding the rest of the engine's settings — additional stores, model selection per purpose, and the `mcp.write.enabled_stores` allowlist that turns the write tools on.
environmentVariables.name: PARTICLES_CONFIG

packageArguments.description: The CLI command group that hosts the Model Context Protocol surface.
Serve the belief store over stdio. Read-only by default: the read tools are always registered, and the write tools are added only for stores explicitly listed in `mcp.write.enabled_stores`.
